notes.title: Raimodula ver. 1.1.5.0
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*]Resolved an issue with double inputs occurring when Steam Input is enabled.
[*]You can now select the same character in 2-player mode. Yay!
[/list]

notes.title: Raimodula Soundtrack is now available!
notes.content:
[b]Good news, everyone![/b]

As requested by our players, we are proud to release the full Raimodula soundtrack! All songs played in the game, tweaked and in MP3 format, available for download! And best of all: [b]free of charge![/b]

Now you can blast the game music whenever you want!

Enjoy! :)
